angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 997,791 km at 108.47 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.2189 +/- 0.0160 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 108.47 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.434 (1.405 to 1.463) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 997,791 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.166 (1.126 to 1.206) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6054 +/- 1.3 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4321678767076043264: teff_gspphot 6054.2407 K (16th-84th percentiles 6053.127-6055.71), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4321678767076043264: teff_gspphot 6054.2407 K (16th-84th percentiles 6053.127-6055.71), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/uruk.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.192, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.47, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): age 3.43 Gyr, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.2 d, from Fischer et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...669.1336F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 231701 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4 km/s, from Fischer et al. 2007 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2007ApJ...669.1336F/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.434 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.673. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
